searchText: but full withdrawals can be anything over 16eth so you would need to try to match eth coming in to coming going out and it just sounds like a lot of work for not much gain — not accounting for the issuance on the beacon chain that's why I mean if we didn't have BLS accounts: there are no ETH1 prefix accounts with more than 48ETH currently. The edge cases are mass slashings were validators make full withdrawals with less than the ejection balance
